name: dir-backlog-to-sir
brief: Convert the DIR-era deferred work into SIR-readable records. Six parallel triage tasks read the 181 items of .dir-sdlc/backlog.md (in five heading-aligned line ranges) and the 17 open or part-done rows of the audit register, and record each with a disposition (carry, drop with recorded evidence, or defer-permanent for MASTER-158 only) in triage files under this session's directory, against a frozen row format and a frozen 13-bundle vocabulary. A seventh task seeds .sir/lessons.md with the 18 instrument-catalogue forms and nine process lessons, each dated, attributed and cited. A fan-in task assembles .sir/backlog.md: one entry per carried row, preserving the original date and DIR session id, a back-pointer, and the marker re-measure before scheduling, grouped under session-bundle headings. Evidence is recorded records only, never source code; nothing outside .sir/ changes.
